title: Relieve · verb
subtitle: 「緩解／減輕／舒緩／安撫」，究竟是哪一種 relieve？
description: 「緩解／減輕／舒緩／安撫」，究竟是哪一種 relieve？

words.note: 使用者提供。ease 是 relieve 最核心、最自然的近義詞之一，常用於 pain, tension, pressure, anxiety, congestion 等。它強調讓不適、壓力或困難變得較輕，而不一定完全消除。
words.example: A short break helped ease the tension in the room.

exercises.original: The new seating arrangement helped relieve pressure on the crowded waiting area.
exercises.zh: 新的座位安排有助緩解擁擠候診區的壓力。

options.explanation: pressure on the crowded waiting area describes strain becoming less severe, a classic ease pressure use.
中性地降低 degree, severity, impact, burden，重點是程度變小。 本題的決定性線索是 reducing pressure or strain；這裡需要的是「緩解壓力／不適」。因此 lessen 雖與 relieve 有語義重疊，但究竟是一般程度降低、正式問題緩解、風險控制、量化減少，還是安撫情緒／不適並不最吻合。
較正式，常與 hardship, symptoms, congestion, suffering 搭配。 本題的決定性線索是 reducing pressure or strain；這裡需要的是「緩解壓力／不適」。因此 alleviate 雖與 relieve 有語義重疊，但究竟是一般程度降低、正式問題緩解、風險控制、量化減少，還是安撫情緒／不適並不最吻合。

words.meaning: 緩解；減輕（問題、痛苦、困難）

words.example: The programme aims to alleviate financial hardship.

exercises.original: The subsidy is intended to relieve financial hardship among low-income households.

words.meaning: 緩和；減輕；安撫（憂慮、內疚、恐懼）
words.note: 較正式。assuage 常與 fears, concerns, anxiety, guilt, doubts, hunger 等搭配，表示減弱強烈的不安、憂慮或心理需求。它比 soothe 更書面，也更常直接搭配抽象情緒名詞。
words.example: The statement did little to assuage public concern.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者高度接近；ease 很自然於 pain/tension/pressure/stress，語氣較日常。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A short break eased the tension. The medicine relieved the pain.

falseSynonyms.zh: alleviate 較正式，常用於 hardship/symptoms/congestion/suffering；relieve 更日常、更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The policy aims to alleviate hardship. The tablets relieved the pain.

falseSynonyms.zh: reduce 只表示數量／程度下降；relieve 更容易帶『解除不適／負擔』的感覺。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The changes reduced waiting times. The rest relieved her discomfort.

falseSynonyms.zh: mitigate 偏向風險、損害與負面後果的減輕；一般肌肉緊張或情緒不適不一定用 mitigate。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The barriers mitigate flood risk. The massage relieved tension.

falseSynonyms.zh: soothe 強調鎮靜、安撫、帶來舒適；relieve 不一定有 calming quality。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The cream soothed irritated skin. The treatment relieved pressure.

falseSynonyms.zh: assuage 較正式，特別常配 fears/concerns/guilt/anxiety；一般量化減少不適用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The statement assuaged public concern. The changes reduced costs.

falseSynonyms.zh: cure 表示消除疾病或根本問題；relieve 只需減輕症狀／不適，不代表治癒。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The treatment relieved the symptoms. It did not cure the condition.

falseSynonyms.zh: relieve 是動詞；relief 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The medicine relieved the pain. The medicine provided relief.
